name: THE GIBSON SPIRIT
description: William Hope's 1919 photograph of Mr and Mrs Gibson, presented at the time as showing the spirit of their deceased son. The archive identifies Hope as a known paranormal hoaxer.

name: THE TWEEDALE APPARITION
description: A William Hope photograph of Reverend Charles L. Tweedale and his wife, presented as showing the spirit of her deceased father.

name: THE LEVERSON PHOTOGRAPH
description: An alleged spirit photograph by William Hope showing Hortense Leverson with an apparition said to be her deceased husband.

name: THE LONGCAKE PHOTOGRAPH
description: A William Hope image presented as showing Mrs Longcake alongside the supposed spirit of her deceased sister-in-law.

name: THE PLAGUE DOCTOR
description: A nineteenth-century plague-doctor engraving published in The Mirror of Literature, Amusement, and Instruction, based on an earlier plague-treatise image.

name: DANSE MACABRE
description: A surviving image connected to the 1922 silent production Danse Macabre.
